Booz Allen Hamilton is a publicly traded provider of management consulting, technology, and engineering services to the US government. 5,000+ employees, headquartered in Washington DC.

Required Qualifications:
- 8+ years of experience with monitoring, logging, and observability platforms such as Prometheus, Grafana, and ELK stack.
- 8+ years of experience with Linux systems administration and networking fundamentals within AWS.
- Experience with Python scripting and automation.
- Experience with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and Terragrunt.
- Knowledge of Kubernetes administration, troubleshooting, and operations.
- TS/SCI clearance with a polygraph.
- Bachelor's degree and 8+ years of experience in SRE, DevOps Engineering, or Platform Engineering, OR 12+ years of experience without a degree.

DevSecOps Engineer

Salary: $135,000 - $220,000 | Location: Remote (United States) | Full Time | 5 years experience
Visa Sponsorship: Not Available | Must live/work in the U.S.
Seed funded: $27M (Jan 2025)

About Istari Digital:
Istari is a digital engineering software company building open, scalable infrastructure for engineering data. Their platform lets customers simply and securely integrate engineering models across disciplines, organizations, and security levels. 51-200 employees, Cambridge, MA.

Core Responsibilities:
- Design, implement, and maintain secure, scalable infrastructure in AWS.
- Manage, secure, and improve Kubernetes-based environments, including production workloads.
- Build and maintain infrastructure as code using Terraform.
- Harden production systems across cloud, compute, container, identity, and network layers.
- Support compliance initiatives, audits, evidence collection, and technical control validation.
- Support identity and access management: least privilege, role design, privileged access controls.
- Partner with engineering teams to improve security within CI/CD pipelines and deployment workflows.
- Participate in incident response and post-incident analysis.

Required Qualifications:
- Minimum 5 years in DevOps, DevSecOps, Infrastructure Engineering, Platform Engineering, or Security Engineering.
- Strong hands-on experience with AWS in production.
- Proven Kubernetes experience in production.
- Strong Terraform and IaC experience.
- Experience hardening production environments and supporting compliance frameworks (SOC 2, NIST, ISO 27001, CMMC).
- Experience configuring and maintaining both Linux and Windows VMs.
- Must live/work in the U.S.

Preferred:
- EKS, Active Directory, Ansible/PowerShell, Python/Bash/PowerShell scripting.
- Security+ Certification.
- Top Secret Security Clearance (preferred).

What You'll Own:
- Cloud infrastructure design and implementation (AWS preferred).
- CI/CD pipelines, environment management, and deployment automation.
- Observability, monitoring, alerting, and incident response.
- Reliability and performance of core services: agent orchestration, data pipelines, API layers.
- Security hardening and secrets management.
- Infrastructure-as-code and reproducible environments.

Ideal Background:
- 5+ years in Infrastructure, DevOps, or SRE roles.
- Strong experience with AWS and IaC (Terraform, CDK).
- Comfortable with containers, Kubernetes or ECS, and modern CI/CD.
- Experience in fintech, crypto, or regulated environments is a significant plus.
- Bonus: blockchain nodes, indexer infrastructure, or agentic/LLM systems.

Founding DevOps Engineer

About AlgoTest:
AlgoTest (YC S22) is an algorithmic options trading platform for Indian retail traders, enabling day traders to use the same technology as top hedge funds and HFT firms.

Position Overview:
You will play a pivotal role in orchestration, networking, and maintenance of the trading infrastructure, working closely with founders and engineers to provide a scalable platform for retail consumers.

Responsibilities:
- Architect and deploy the core infrastructure ensuring scalability, reliability, and security.
- Write clean, maintainable CI/CD pipelines and IaC modules with Terraform.
- Collaborate with the team to define the technical roadmap.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, or related field.
- 2+ years as a DevOps/Platform engineer, preferably in a fast-paced environment.
- Strong proficiency in orchestration, networking, CI/CD automation servers, and IaC frameworks in a cloud-agnostic manner.
- Experience implementing automation pipelines and maintaining multiple environments.
- Self-driven, entrepreneurial mindset.

Preferred: Prior experience in trading or financial industry (trading systems, market data, algorithmic trading).

Technology: Scalable execution platform automating thousands of user-built strategies on AWS in real time, built around a Flask microservice.

Interview Process: Intro call covering deployments/networking basics and resume review, followed by a take-home assignment, then a deeper technical round on your solution.

DevOps Engineer (Latin America, Remote)

About Etleap:
Etleap (YC-backed) builds an intuitive ETL/ELT tool that makes it quick to integrate data from any source without writing code and efficient to manage hundreds or thousands of data pipelines. Backed by First Round Capital, SV Angel, and Y Combinator. Powered by complex, autoscaling, fault-tolerant AWS infrastructure.

Note: This role is open to individuals living in Latin America.

What You Will Do:
- Perform system troubleshooting and root cause analysis for infrastructure issues across back-end systems and SaaS products.
- Evolve AWS production and test infrastructure to add functionality and improve availability and reliability.
- Manage and evolve CircleCI-based CI/CD pipelines to minimize build time and maximize build stability.
- Evolve the Terraform module (registry.terraform.io/modules/etleap/etleap-vpc) to add functionality and improve uptime and resiliency.
- Recommend and implement improvements to the release process.
- Own tools for process automation and identify more manual processes to automate.
- Manage and evolve logging, metrics, and monitoring systems.
- Test and apply security upgrades for infrastructure and software.

Required Qualifications:
- 5+ years of DevOps experience with AWS-based infrastructure.
- 3+ years Terraform experience.
- Network administration knowledge.
- Experience with Linux administration and Docker.
- Comfortable with Bash and Python scripting.
- Strong English proficiency, written and verbal.

Bonus: Java/JVM experience, VPN site-to-site connections (IPSec or WireGuard).

Platform / Infrastructure Engineer (Voice AI)

About Freya:
Freya (YC S25) builds voice AI call centers for regulated industries: banks, insurance, and enterprise call centers. Raised $3.5M. Their agents answer real customer calls in on-premises environments inside banks.

About the Role:
You will own the backbone that runs thousands of concurrent AI-powered phone calls inside bank-grade on-premise environments. You architect distributed systems handling real-time voice, scale STT/LLM/TTS inference across customer GPU clusters, integrate with enterprise telephony (Cisco CUBE, Genesys, Asterisk), and deploy behind the firewalls of the largest financial institutions.

What You'll Do:
- Own on-prem deployments into OpenShift clusters inside banks: Helm charts, image registries, GPU allocation, CyberArk integration, SAML 2.0/OIDC SSO.
- Scale GPU inference infrastructure for STT, TTS, and LLM models across multiple customer environments (H100/H200, NVLink, Triton or vLLM).
- Integrate with telephony: Asterisk, SIP trunks, Cisco CUBE, Genesys, WebRTC, SIP header parsing, direction routing, warm transfers, DTMF.
- Own reliability: Splunk SIEM forwarding, Langfuse and Grafana observability, incident playbooks for bank-grade 24/7 SLAs.
- Security and compliance: RBAC, pentest remediation, KVKK and BDDK compliance patterns, pod security policies.
- Onboard a new bank or insurer every quarter, each a new on-prem environment with its own constraints.

What Makes You a Great Fit:
- 3+ years building and scaling distributed systems. Deep Kubernetes/OpenShift knowledge. AWS/GCP helpful.
- Real-time systems experience: low-latency streaming or inference. Voice/video is a big plus.
- On-prem mentality: shipped software into environments you did not fully control.
- Familiar with: Kubernetes/OpenShift, Helm, Docker, Terraform, NVIDIA GPU stack, Asterisk, SIP, Cisco CUBE, Genesys, Splunk, Grafana, CyberArk, Python or Go.

Bonus: Telephony (SIP, VoIP, WebRTC), ML infrastructure/GPU computing (Triton, vLLM, TensorRT), real-time audio processing, banking/fintech/BDDK/KVKK compliance, fluent Turkish.

How to Apply: Email dev@freyavoice.ai with a short note about the hardest infra problem you have shipped and your CV.
